speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Health, given the commitment to strengthen the Singaporean Core in the nursing profession, whether the Government will review the total compensation of Singaporean nurses to bring it more in line with nursing wages in developed countries.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In setting salaries of most occupations, the salient consideration is the conditions of the local market, while taking into consideration the international market, if relevant.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In this regard, MOH regularly reviews the salaries of nurses and other healthcare staff to ensure market competitiveness.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Nurses' salaries take into account both local and global references.
